fl-fsr-02.front: Kilometre signs going up. What do you call?

fl-fsr-03.front: The basic radio call, in order?
fl-fsr-03.back: Road name, kilometre, up or down, plus anything the sign asks (65 to 95%).

fl-fsr-04.back: Yes, a mobile radio licence (ISED); a radio shop programs it (95%).
